dimension_reasoning.substantive_criticism: The response makes multiple distinct critical claims: weaponization of sedition law against journalists (e.g., Siddique Kappan arrest), Information Technology Rules enabling censorship via vague 'fake news' definitions, economic coercion through advertising withdrawal (e.g., from The Hindu, The Telegraph), tax raids as intimidation (BBC India, Newslaundry), FCRA amendments crippling NGOs (6,000 losing licenses), and UAPA deployment against activists (Bhima Koregaon case).
